config.notes: UWA course pages are plain HTML (www.uwa.edu.au/study/courses/<slug>), no page data. Two templates: undergraduate "Quick details" (Course code, CRICOS code, TISC code, Intake <months>, Duration, Location, Minimum ATAR) and postgraduate/research "Quick details" (Status, Locations, Attendance, Delivery, Starting dates, Level of study, Course Code, CRICOS code, Full time/part time duration). Research pages say "Throughout the year excluding January & December" (not readable as months); postgraduate coursework often says "Semester 1" (no month). IELTS is printed only where a course has higher English requirements ("IELTS Academic require an overall score of at least X"). Course pages carry NO international fee figure: only a link to the Fee Calculator (fees.uwa.edu.au). 190 stored links are internal CMS paths (/sitecore/content/uwafs/home/courses/<slug>) blocked by robots.txt; the public page is /study/courses/<slug>.
